daily.today_energy: The cosmos is whispering secrets just for you today, Scorpio. There's a quiet intensity building—trust your instincts and let your natural magnetism do the heavy lifting. Something shifts beneath the surface.

daily.career: Your ideas have teeth today. This is the moment to pitch that thing you've been sitting on or take initiative on something that's been calling to you. Your intuition about next moves is basically a cheat code.
daily.health: Your body's asking you to slow down and actually listen. Whether it's rest, movement, or just hydration—honor what feels right. Your energy levels are tied to how much you trust yourself today.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to lean into your natural magnetism. The cosmos is rewarding your authenticity, so shed what no longer serves you. Trust the quiet knowing that's been nudging you lately—it's rarely wrong.
weekly.love: Connection deepens through vulnerability this week. Whether single or partnered, someone's paying attention to the real you. Don't dim your light trying to be easier to love. The right people are already mesmerized.
weekly.career: Your instincts are *chef's kiss* right now. That project idea brewing in your mind? Worth exploring. Your ability to see what others miss is your superpower this week. Let it guide your next move.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional rest, not just sleep. Move in ways that feel good—maybe that's dancing, stretching, or just existing without an agenda. You're allowed to prioritize feeling over doing.
